name: zenstudios-quotes
description: Quotation, project and margin management for ZenStudios (OMHome Services Pvt Ltd)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.app: npm run build && npm run build:server && npm run start -w desktop
scripts.app:dist: npm run build && npm run build:server && npm run dist -w desktop
